source.title: Classification, Characterization, and Contextualization of Windows Malware using Static Behavior and Similarity Analysis
source.author: Daniel Plohmann
source.note: Transcribed from the published document. Figures are as printed; nothing here is re-measured.

GB.name: ByteWeight
GB.note: 32- and 64-bit Windows PE, Microsoft Visual Studio, O1 and O2
GB.truth: 102,532 function start and end locations; no instruction borders

GB_star.name: ByteWeight*
GB_star.note: the GB binaries memory-dumped, code shifted from RVA 0x400 to 0x1000, PE headers overwritten with null bytes

GA.name: Andriesse
GA.note: 304 SPEC binaries at O0-O3, 20 servers, one 64-bit glibc; 803,602 functions, 55,698,481 instructions

GM.name: Malpedia57
GM.method: memory dumps loaded in IDA Pro with no code detection heuristics enabled, then manually annotated; effort capped at 80 hours

table_6_3_manual_labelling_quality.caption: Quality of manual labeling against the ByteWeight ground truth. A function counts as correct only when its start and every instruction to its end match.
stated_limitations: most false negatives are unreferenced nullsubs, a single C3 (retn) instruction
client7z's 249 false positives are a ByteWeight ground-truth gap: the functions are genuinely referenced by other code but absent from the PDB-derived truth

table_6_4_fep_reliability_by_refcount.caption: Reliability of function entry point detection (prologue, code reference and gap search combined) provided by SMDA. Refcount 0 means the start came from gap search.

table_6_5_disassembler_comparison.caption: Recall and precision of function entry point discovery. Values are (TPR, PPV).
table_6_5_disassembler_comparison.aggregation: geometric mean per optimization level for rows labelled O0-O3; arithmetic mean over all binaries for rows with no such label

instruction_recovery_on_GM.note: nucleus's precision on GM is 0.480; its linear sweep reads much data as code

thunk_convention: All four disassemblers report the jmp thunks a Visual Studio incremental link emits in a PE, and the paper includes every such stub in the ground truth. External functions represented only by an offset are discarded using the disassembler's own external flag.
design_goals: produce the same result whether the input is an unmapped file with full context or shellcode with none
completeness over precision: FEP discovery and gap analysis are deliberately aggressive and the resulting false positives are accepted
memory dumps of Windows malware are the target case, not on-disk executables
